title: The State of the US Left w/ Arun Gupta
author: CounterPunch Radio
content:
Journalist Arun Gupta returns to CounterPunch Radio to discuss the state of
the left, antiwar politics, and much more. Arun talks to host Eric Draitser
and provides his analysis of the No Kings movement and how leftists should
understand it, as well as a retrospective of the antiwar movements around Iraq
and Vietnam. He explores the importance of physical community and organization
using the example of New York's Lower East Side, where he resides. The
conversation also touches on the Left's historic role in countering the
hegemonic view of global affairs. A devoted leftist, Marxist, investigative
journalist, chef, and food tour guide, Arun Gupta always brings incisive
analysis and thoughtful critique to CounterPunch.

The post [The State of the US Left w/ Arun
Gupta](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/05/29/the-state-of-the-us-left-w-
arun-gupta/) appeared first on
[CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
